packages_list.name: Kintamani - Ubud Tour
packages_list.description: The Kintamani–Ubud Tour is a perfect journey to explore Bali’s natural beauty, cultural heritage, and iconic destinations in one unforgettable trip.
packages_list.hightlight: Start at the Silver & Gold Gallery and Batik Factory to explore Bali's finest crafts, then head up to Kintamani Volcanofor a stunning crater view. Purify yourself at the sacred Tirta Empul Holy Spring, feel the thrill at Tegalalang Rice Terrace & Swing, and wrap up the day soaking in the royal culture of Ubud Palace.
packages_list.include: English speaking driver, 1 bottle mineral water, Parking and entrance fee based on above programs
packages_list.exclude: Trevel insurance, Optionals tour, Any personal expenses, Gradtuities for tour dirver
